eyebrow: Evals · how I know the AI works
title: I don't ship AI I can't measure
subtitle: Evaluation frameworks I designed and built for three agentic security products: adversarial test suites, release gates that block a bad model change, and scoring of production traces.
disclaimer: Built with Langfuse. Every eval, dataset, score and trace shown here was generated in Langfuse, the open-source LLM engineering platform. These are demo evals run on synthetic data: the alerts, threats, documents and evidence are made up for illustration, not customer data. The numbers show how the method works, not results from a live deployment.
